items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] I heard him play on the roof garden with the Superior Band.

ctx.x: Did Buddy Johnson ever work with him? They had a brown skin fella they called, uh, used to play with him then. Um, Ducey. Ducey. Ducey. Frankie Ducey. Frankie Ducey. Frankie Ducey. Oh, Frankie Ducey. Yeah, Frankie Ducey. He was playing with them too. Did you ever hear Dutre? Nori Dutre they called him.

Played Cranet? No, uh, trombone. He was with Joe Oliver later. He left here pretty early though. I think he'd never played here much after he was. But I mean, is he akin to Dutre the Tranny, please? Yeah, Sam Dutre. Yeah, Sam. He was his brother. Oh yeah, well I remember Sam Dutre, but I don't remember him.
I guess Nori, the trombone that's left here when he was pretty young. Is his name again? Uh, playing trombone too. He was a good trombone player too.
